paragraphs.en: Open the .dmg and drag cmux to your Applications folder. cmux auto-updates via Sparkle, so you only need to download once.
paragraphs.zh: 打开 .dmg 文件，将 cmux 拖到你的「应用程序」文件夹中。cmux 通过 Sparkle 自动更新，因此你只需下载一次。

paragraphs.en: brew tap manaflow-ai/cmux brew install --cask cmux To update later:
paragraphs.zh: brew tap manaflow-ai/cmux brew install --cask cmux 若要以后更新：

paragraphs.en: brew upgrade --cask cmux On first launch, macOS may ask you to confirm opening an app from an identified developer. Click Open to proceed.
paragraphs.zh: brew upgrade --cask cmux 首次启动时，macOS 可能会要求你确认打开来自已认证开发者的应用。点击“打开”以继续。

paragraphs.en: The Homebrew cask installs completions for zsh, bash, and fish. Start a new shell after installing. If they don't load, make sure Homebrew's completion directories are wired into your shell (see Homebrew's shell completion docs ).
paragraphs.zh: Homebrew cask 会安装 zsh、bash 和 fish 的补全。 安装后请启动一个新的 shell。 如果补全没有加载，请确保 Homebrew 的补全目录已接入你的 shell（参见 Homebrew 的 shell 补全文档）。

sents.en: The Homebrew cask installs completions for zsh, bash, and fish.
sents.zh: Homebrew cask 会安装 zsh、bash 和 fish 的补全。

sents.en: Start a new shell after installing.
sents.zh: 安装后请启动一个新的 shell。

sents.en: If they don't load, make sure Homebrew's completion directories are wired into your shell (see Homebrew's shell completion docs ).
sents.zh: 如果补全没有加载，请确保 Homebrew 的补全目录已接入你的 shell（参见 Homebrew 的 shell 补全文档）。

paragraphs.en: If you installed cmux another way, add the matching line to your shell startup file, then start a new shell:
paragraphs.zh: 如果你是通过其他方式安装的 cmux，请将对应的行添加到你的 shell 启动文件中，然后启动一个新的 shell：

paragraphs.en: autoload -Uz compinit && compinit eval " $( cmux completion zsh ) " eval " $( cmux completion bash ) " cmux completion fish | source Why cmux? I run a lot of Claude Code and Codex sessions in parallel. I was using Ghostty with a bunch of split panes, and relying on native macOS notifications to know when an agent needed me. But Claude Code's notification body is always just "Claude is waiting for your input" with no context, and with enough tabs open I couldn't even read the titles anymore.
paragraphs.zh: autoload -Uz compinit && compinit eval " $( cmux completion zsh ) " eval " $( cmux completion bash ) " cmux completion fish | source 为什么选择 cmux？ 我会同时并行运行许多 Claude Code 和 Codex 会话。 之前我用 Ghostty 开了一堆分屏面板，依靠 macOS 原生通知来获知某个智能体何时需要我。 但 Claude Code 的通知正文始终只是「Claude 正在等待你的输入」，没有任何上下文，而且打开的标签页一多，我连标题都看不清了。

sents.en: autoload -Uz compinit && compinit eval " $( cmux completion zsh ) " eval " $( cmux completion bash ) " cmux completion fish | source Why cmux?
sents.zh: autoload -Uz compinit && compinit eval " $( cmux completion zsh ) " eval " $( cmux completion bash ) " cmux completion fish | source 为什么选择 cmux？

sents.en: I run a lot of Claude Code and Codex sessions in parallel.
sents.zh: 我会同时并行运行许多 Claude Code 和 Codex 会话。

sents.en: I was using Ghostty with a bunch of split panes, and relying on native macOS notifications to know when an agent needed me.
sents.zh: 之前我用 Ghostty 开了一堆分屏面板，依靠 macOS 原生通知来获知某个智能体何时需要我。

sents.en: But Claude Code's notification body is always just "Claude is waiting for your input" with no context, and with enough tabs open I couldn't even read the titles anymore.
sents.zh: 但 Claude Code 的通知正文始终只是「Claude 正在等待你的输入」，没有任何上下文，而且打开的标签页一多，我连标题都看不清了。

paragraphs.en: I tried a few coding orchestrators but most of them were Electron/Tauri apps and the performance bugged me. I also just prefer the terminal since GUI orchestrators lock you into their workflow. So I built cmux as a native macOS app in Swift/AppKit. It uses libghostty for terminal rendering and reads your existing Ghostty config for themes, fonts, and colors.
paragraphs.zh: 我试过几个编码编排器，但它们大多是 Electron/Tauri 应用，性能让我很头疼。 我也更喜欢终端，因为图形界面的编排器会把你锁定在它们的工作流程里。 所以我用 Swift/AppKit 把 cmux 构建成了一个原生 macOS 应用。 它使用 libghostty 进行终端渲染，并读取你现有的 Ghostty 配置来应用主题、字体和颜色。

sents.en: I tried a few coding orchestrators but most of them were Electron/Tauri apps and the performance bugged me.
sents.zh: 我试过几个编码编排器，但它们大多是 Electron/Tauri 应用，性能让我很头疼。

sents.en: I also just prefer the terminal since GUI orchestrators lock you into their workflow.
sents.zh: 我也更喜欢终端，因为图形界面的编排器会把你锁定在它们的工作流程里。

sents.en: So I built cmux as a native macOS app in Swift/AppKit.
sents.zh: 所以我用 Swift/AppKit 把 cmux 构建成了一个原生 macOS 应用。

sents.en: It uses libghostty for terminal rendering and reads your existing Ghostty config for themes, fonts, and colors.
sents.zh: 它使用 libghostty 进行终端渲染，并读取你现有的 Ghostty 配置来应用主题、字体和颜色。

paragraphs.en: The main additions are the sidebar and notification system. The sidebar has vertical tabs that show git branch, linked PR status/number, working directory, listening ports, and the latest notification text for each workspace. The notification system picks up terminal sequences (OSC 9/99/777) and has a CLI ( cmux notify ) you can wire into agent hooks for Claude Code, OpenCode, etc. When an agent is waiting, its pane gets a blue ring and the tab lights up in the sidebar, so I can tell which one needs me across splits and tabs. Cmd+Shift+U jumps to the most recent unread.
paragraphs.zh: 主要的新增内容是侧边栏和通知系统。 侧边栏带有垂直标签页，显示每个工作区的 git 分支、关联 PR 的状态/编号、工作目录、监听端口以及最新的通知文本。 通知系统可以捕获终端序列（OSC 9/99/777），并提供一个 CLI（cmux notify），你可以将其接入 Claude Code、OpenCode 等工具的智能体钩子中。 当某个智能体在等待时，它的面板会出现蓝色圆环，其标签页也会在侧边栏中亮起，这样我就能在多个分屏和标签页之间分辨出哪一个需要我处理。 按 Cmd+Shift+U 可跳转到最近的一条未读通知。

sents.en: The main additions are the sidebar and notification system.
sents.zh: 主要的新增内容是侧边栏和通知系统。

sents.en: The sidebar has vertical tabs that show git branch, linked PR status/number, working directory, listening ports, and the latest notification text for each workspace.
sents.zh: 侧边栏带有垂直标签页，显示每个工作区的 git 分支、关联 PR 的状态/编号、工作目录、监听端口以及最新的通知文本。

sents.en: The notification system picks up terminal sequences (OSC 9/99/777) and has a CLI ( cmux notify ) you can wire into agent hooks for Claude Code, OpenCode, etc.
sents.zh: 通知系统可以捕获终端序列（OSC 9/99/777），并提供一个 CLI（cmux notify），你可以将其接入 Claude Code、OpenCode 等工具的智能体钩子中。

sents.en: When an agent is waiting, its pane gets a blue ring and the tab lights up in the sidebar, so I can tell which one needs me across splits and tabs.
sents.zh: 当某个智能体在等待时，它的面板会出现蓝色圆环，其标签页也会在侧边栏中亮起，这样我就能在多个分屏和标签页之间分辨出哪一个需要我处理。

sents.en: Cmd+Shift+U jumps to the most recent unread.
sents.zh: 按 Cmd+Shift+U 可跳转到最近的一条未读通知。

paragraphs.en: The in-app browser has a scriptable API ported from agent-browser . Agents can snapshot the accessibility tree, get element refs, click, fill forms, and evaluate JS. You can split a browser pane next to your terminal and have Claude Code interact with your dev server directly.
paragraphs.zh: 应用内浏览器提供了一个从 agent-browser 移植而来的可脚本化 API。 智能体可以对无障碍树进行快照、获取元素引用、点击、填写表单并执行 JavaScript。 你可以在终端旁边拆分出一个浏览器窗格，让 Claude Code 直接与你的开发服务器交互。

sents.en: The in-app browser has a scriptable API ported from agent-browser .
sents.zh: 应用内浏览器提供了一个从 agent-browser 移植而来的可脚本化 API。

sents.en: Agents can snapshot the accessibility tree, get element refs, click, fill forms, and evaluate JS.
sents.zh: 智能体可以对无障碍树进行快照、获取元素引用、点击、填写表单并执行 JavaScript。

sents.en: You can split a browser pane next to your terminal and have Claude Code interact with your dev server directly.
sents.zh: 你可以在终端旁边拆分出一个浏览器窗格，让 Claude Code 直接与你的开发服务器交互。

paragraphs.en: Everything is scriptable through the CLI and socket API — create workspaces/tabs, split panes, send keystrokes, open URLs in the browser.
paragraphs.zh: 一切均可通过 CLI 和套接字 API 进行脚本化——创建工作区/标签页、拆分窗格、发送按键、在浏览器中打开 URL。

paragraphs.en: cmux is not prescriptive about how developers hold their tools. It's a terminal and browser with a CLI, and the rest is up to you.
paragraphs.zh: cmux 并不规定开发者该如何使用他们的工具。 它是一个带 CLI 的终端和浏览器，其余的完全由你决定。

paragraphs.en: cmux is a primitive, not a solution. It gives you a terminal, a browser, notifications, workspaces, splits, tabs, and a CLI to control all of it. cmux doesn't force you into an opinionated way to use coding agents. What you build with the primitives is yours.
paragraphs.zh: cmux 是一个基础构件，而不是一个解决方案。 它为你提供终端、浏览器、通知、工作区、分屏、标签页，以及一个可以控制所有这些功能的命令行工具（CLI）。cmux 不会强迫你以某种固定的方式来使用编程智能体。 你用这些基础构件构建出来的东西，属于你自己。

sents.en: cmux is a primitive, not a solution.
sents.zh: cmux 是一个基础构件，而不是一个解决方案。

sents.en: It gives you a terminal, a browser, notifications, workspaces, splits, tabs, and a CLI to control all of it. cmux doesn't force you into an opinionated way to use coding agents.

sents.en: What you build with the primitives is yours.
sents.zh: 你用这些基础构件构建出来的东西，属于你自己。

paragraphs.en: The best developers have always built their own tools. Nobody has figured out the best way to work with agents yet, and the teams building closed products definitely haven't either. The developers closest to their own codebases will figure it out first.
paragraphs.zh: 最优秀的开发者一直在构建自己的工具。 目前还没有人找到与智能体协作的最佳方式，而打造封闭产品的团队肯定也没有找到。 最贴近自己代码库的开发者会最先找到答案。

sents.en: The best developers have always built their own tools.
sents.zh: 最优秀的开发者一直在构建自己的工具。

sents.en: Nobody has figured out the best way to work with agents yet, and the teams building closed products definitely haven't either.
sents.zh: 目前还没有人找到与智能体协作的最佳方式，而打造封闭产品的团队肯定也没有找到。

sents.en: The developers closest to their own codebases will figure it out first.
sents.zh: 最贴近自己代码库的开发者会最先找到答案。

paragraphs.en: Give a million developers composable primitives and they'll collectively find the most efficient workflows faster than any product team could design top-down.
paragraphs.zh:
给一百万名开发者可组合的基础构件，他们 collectively 找到最高效工作流的速度，会比任何产品团队自上而下设计得更快。

等等，我需要修正——按要求直接输出翻译结果：

给一百万名开发者可组合的基础构件，他们 collectively 找到最高效工作流的速度，会比任何产品团队自上而下设计得更快。

抱歉，以下是干净的最终译文：

给一百万名开发者可组合的基础构件，他们整体找到最高效工作流的速度，会快于任何产品团队自上而下的设计。

paragraphs.en: For more info on how to configure cmux, head over to our docs .
paragraphs.zh: 有关如何配置 cmux 的更多信息，请前往我们的文档。

paragraphs.en: To theme cmux (colors, fonts, transparency, sidebar, and more), see Customizing cmux's look .
paragraphs.zh: 要为 cmux 主题化（颜色、字体、透明度、侧边栏等），请参阅「自定义 cmux 外观」。

paragraphs.en: For shell watcher churn and managed-Mac process audit volume, see the supported CMUX_NO_GIT_WATCH=1 mitigation and its Git/PR update trade-offs.
paragraphs.zh: 关于 shell 监视器频繁变更与受管 Mac 进程审计量的问题，请参阅受支持的 CMUX_NO_GIT_WATCH=1 缓解方案及其在 Git/PR 更新方面的权衡。

paragraphs.en: Browser developer-tool shortcuts follow Safari defaults and are customizable in Settings → Keyboard Shortcuts . Command palette navigation shortcuts, including ⌃ P, are also customizable and can be cleared so the keypress reaches the active terminal.
paragraphs.zh: 浏览器开发者工具快捷键遵循 Safari 默认设置，并可在「设置 → 键盘快捷键」中自定义。 命令面板导航快捷键（包括 ⌃ P）同样可以自定义，也可以清除，从而让按键传递到当前活动的终端。

paragraphs.en: Download cmux NIGHTLY (universal; updates then switch to your Mac's architecture automatically)
paragraphs.zh: 下载 cmux NIGHTLY（通用版；更新后会自动切换到你的 Mac 所支持的架构）

paragraphs.en: cmux NIGHTLY is a separate app with its own bundle ID, so it runs alongside the stable version. Built automatically from the latest main commit and auto-updates via its own Sparkle feed.
paragraphs.zh: cmux NIGHTLY 是一个独立的应用，拥有自己的 bundle ID，因此可与稳定版并存运行。 它从最新的 main 提交自动构建，并通过自己的 Sparkle 更新源自动更新。

paragraphs.en: cmux does not checkpoint arbitrary live process state. Ordinary terminals, tmux, vim, shells, and unsupported terminal apps reopen as normal terminals. For live detach/reattach across cmux quit, crashes, and updates, opt in to the local tmux owner with cmux local-tmux ; see docs/local-tmux.md for its lifecycle and machine-sleep limits. zellij users can use cmux local-zellij instead; see docs/local-zellij.md .
paragraphs.zh: cmux 不会对任意运行中进程的状态做检查点保存。 普通终端、tmux、vim、shell 以及不受支持的终端应用会作为普通终端重新打开。 若要在 cmux 退出、崩溃和更新期间实现实时分离/重连，请选择启用本地 tmux 拥有者，使用 cmux local-tmux ；其生命周期与机器睡眠限制请参阅 docs/local-tmux.md 。zellij 用户可以改用 cmux local-zellij ；请参阅 docs/local-zellij.md 。

paragraphs.en: cmux hooks setup cmux hooks setup codex cmux hooks setup --agent opencode cmux hooks setup installs supported agents it can find and prints a summary for skipped agents. Supported resume integrations include Claude Code, Codex, Grok, OpenCode, Pi, Amp, Cursor CLI, Gemini, Rovo Dev, Copilot, CodeBuddy, Factory, and Qoder. Claude Code is handled by the cmux Claude wrapper when Claude integration is enabled in Settings.
paragraphs.zh: cmux hooks setup cmux hooks setup codex cmux hooks setup --agent opencode cmux hooks setup 会安装它能找到的受支持智能体，并为被跳过的智能体打印一份摘要。 支持的恢复集成包括 Claude Code、Codex、Grok、OpenCode、Pi、Amp、Cursor CLI、Gemini、Rovo Dev、Copilot、CodeBuddy、Factory 和 Qoder。 当 Claude 集成在设置中启用时，Claude Code 由 cmux Claude 包装器处理。

paragraphs.en: Advanced users and integrations can attach a custom resume command to the current terminal surface. This is useful for tools with their own durable state, such as tmux sessions or custom agent CLIs:
paragraphs.zh: 高级用户和集成可以为当前的终端界面附加一个自定义的恢复命令。 这对于拥有自身持久状态的工具非常有用，例如 tmux 会话或自定义智能体 CLI：

sents.en: Advanced users and integrations can attach a custom resume command to the current terminal surface.
sents.zh: 高级用户和集成可以为当前的终端界面附加一个自定义的恢复命令。

sents.en: This is useful for tools with their own durable state, such as tmux sessions or custom agent CLIs:
sents.zh: 这对于拥有自身持久状态的工具非常有用，例如 tmux 会话或自定义智能体 CLI：

paragraphs.en: cmux surface resume set --kind tmux --checkpoint work --shell " tmux attach -t work " cmux surface resume show --json cmux surface resume clear --checkpoint work The binding stays attached to the cmux surface. Public CLI or socket-created bindings are stored for inspection and manual restore unless you approve a signed command prefix for automatic restore. Approved prefixes are also bound to the working directory and exact environment values, when present. Review or edit approvals in Settings > Terminal > Resume Commands . cmux only auto-runs resume bindings it marks trusted, such as live process-detected tmux bindings or user-approved prefixes. Sensitive environment keys such as tokens, passwords, secrets, and API keys are dropped before a resume binding is stored.
paragraphs.zh: cmux surface resume set --kind tmux --checkpoint work --shell " tmux attach -t work " cmux surface resume show --json cmux surface resume clear --checkpoint work 该绑定会保持附加在 cmux surface 上。 通过公共 CLI 或套接字创建的绑定会被存储以便检查和手动恢复，除非你批准了一个签名命令前缀用于自动恢复。 已批准的前缀还会绑定到工作目录以及（若存在）完全一致的环境变量值。 在 Settings > Terminal > Resume Commands 中查看或编辑批准项。cmux 只会自动运行它标记为可信的恢复绑定，例如由活动进程检测到的 tmux 绑定或用户批准的前缀。 在存储恢复绑定之前，诸如令牌、密码、密钥和 API 密钥等敏感环境变量键会被丢弃。

sents.en: cmux surface resume set --kind tmux --checkpoint work --shell " tmux attach -t work " cmux surface resume show --json cmux surface resume clear --checkpoint work The binding stays attached to the cmux surface.
sents.zh: cmux surface resume set --kind tmux --checkpoint work --shell " tmux attach -t work " cmux surface resume show --json cmux surface resume clear --checkpoint work 该绑定会保持附加在 cmux surface 上。

sents.zh: 通过公共 CLI 或套接字创建的绑定会被存储以便检查和手动恢复，除非你批准了一个签名命令前缀用于自动恢复。

sents.en: Approved prefixes are also bound to the working directory and exact environment values, when present.
sents.zh: 已批准的前缀还会绑定到工作目录以及（若存在）完全一致的环境变量值。

sents.en: Review or edit approvals in Settings > Terminal > Resume Commands . cmux only auto-runs resume bindings it marks trusted, such as live process-detected tmux bindings or user-approved prefixes.
sents.zh: 在 Settings > Terminal > Resume Commands 中查看或编辑批准项。cmux 只会自动运行它标记为可信的恢复绑定，例如由活动进程检测到的 tmux 绑定或用户批准的前缀。

sents.zh: 在存储恢复绑定之前，诸如令牌、密码、密钥和 API 密钥等敏感环境变量键会被丢弃。

paragraphs.en: To keep restored agent terminals idle instead of automatically running their resume commands, turn off Settings > Terminal > Resume Agent Sessions on Reopen or set this in ~/.config/cmux/cmux.json :
paragraphs.zh: 若要让恢复的智能体终端保持空闲而不是自动运行其恢复命令，请关闭 设置 > 终端 > 重新打开时恢复智能体会话，或在 ~/.config/cmux/cmux.json 中进行设置：

paragraphs.en: { "terminal" : { "autoResumeAgentSessions" : false } } This only disables automatic agent resume commands. cmux still restores the saved layout, working directories, scrollback, and browser history.
paragraphs.zh: { "terminal" : { "autoResumeAgentSessions" : false } } 这只会禁用自动恢复智能体会话的命令。cmux 仍会恢复已保存的布局、工作目录、回滚缓冲区和浏览器历史记录。

paragraphs.en: If you need to reapply the last saved snapshot manually, use:
paragraphs.zh: 如果您需要手动重新应用上次保存的快照，请使用：

paragraphs.en: Each cmux install (stable, nightly, rc, staging, and tagged debug builds) keeps its own saved session. To bring a session from one install into another, for example after trying nightly and switching back to stable, run this from the install you want to open it in:
paragraphs.zh: 每个 cmux 安装（stable、nightly、rc、staging 以及带标签的调试构建）都保留各自已保存的会话。 要把一个会话从一个安装迁移到另一个安装（例如试用 nightly 后切换回 stable），请在你想打开该会话的安装中运行以下命令：

sents.en: Each cmux install (stable, nightly, rc, staging, and tagged debug builds) keeps its own saved session.
sents.zh: 每个 cmux 安装（stable、nightly、rc、staging 以及带标签的调试构建）都保留各自已保存的会话。

sents.en: To bring a session from one install into another, for example after trying nightly and switching back to stable, run this from the install you want to open it in:
sents.zh: 要把一个会话从一个安装迁移到另一个安装（例如试用 nightly 后切换回 stable），请在你想打开该会话的安装中运行以下命令：

paragraphs.en: cmux restore-session --from nightly # or stable, rc, staging, debug:<tag> cmux restore-session --export ~ /session.json # write this install's saved session to a file cmux restore-session --export ~ /session.json --force # replace an existing export file cmux restore-session --from ~ /session.json # reopen an exported file The imported session opens as additional windows next to the ones you have, like cmux restore-session ; the other install's saved file is only read. Agent resume carries over because hook session mappings in ~/.cmuxterm/ are shared by every install. Browser cookies and logins are per install and do not move.
paragraphs.zh: cmux restore-session --from nightly # 或 stable、rc、staging、debug:<tag> cmux restore-session --export ~ /session.json # 将本次安装保存的会话写入一个文件 cmux restore-session --export ~ /session.json --force # 替换已存在的导出文件 cmux restore-session --from ~ /session.json # 重新打开一个导出的文件 导入的会话会像 cmux restore-session 一样，在你现有窗口旁边以额外窗口的形式打开；另一安装的已保存文件仅被读取。 智能体恢复功能之所以能延续，是因为 ~/.cmuxterm/ 中的钩子会话映射由每次安装共享。 浏览器 Cookie 和登录状态是按安装隔离的，不会随之迁移。

sents.en: cmux restore-session --from nightly # or stable, rc, staging, debug:<tag> cmux restore-session --export ~ /session.json # write this install's saved session to a file cmux restore-session --export ~ /session.json --force # replace an existing export file cmux restore-session --from ~ /session.json # reopen an exported file The imported session opens as additional windows next to the ones you have, like cmux restore-session ; the other install's saved file is only read.
sents.zh: cmux restore-session --from nightly # 或 stable、rc、staging、debug:<tag> cmux restore-session --export ~ /session.json # 将本次安装保存的会话写入一个文件 cmux restore-session --export ~ /session.json --force # 替换已存在的导出文件 cmux restore-session --from ~ /session.json # 重新打开一个导出的文件 导入的会话会像 cmux restore-session 一样，在你现有窗口旁边以额外窗口的形式打开；另一安装的已保存文件仅被读取。

sents.en: Agent resume carries over because hook session mappings in ~/.cmuxterm/ are shared by every install.
sents.zh: 智能体恢复功能之所以能延续，是因为 ~/.cmuxterm/ 中的钩子会话映射由每次安装共享。

sents.en: Browser cookies and logins are per install and do not move.
sents.zh: 浏览器 Cookie 和登录状态是按安装隔离的，不会随之迁移。

paragraphs.en: --from <channel> restores another install's own session file with the same trust as your own session, including automatic agent resume. --from <path> treats the file as untrusted: layout, working directories, text scrollback, and http(s) browser tabs restore, but nothing in the file runs automatically. Built-in agents (Claude Code, Codex, Amp, and the rest) resume with the command cmux builds from the agent kind and session id, ignoring launch arguments stored in the file, and only when the working directory already exists on this Mac. Custom agent resume commands, resume bindings, and tmux start commands are kept for manual restore only (approved resume prefixes never apply to them): the CLI reports how many were held back, and in each terminal cmux surface resume show shows the command and cmux restore --surface runs it. Terminal control sequences in the scrollback (clipboard, notifications, links, titles), draft attachments, non-http(s) browser pages and profiles, SSH/cloud connections, and workspace environment variables from the file are dropped. A snapshot saved by a newer cmux (newer session format) is refused with an error; if a downgraded cmux finds one in its own session file, it keeps a copy next to it as session-<bundle id>.schema-v<N>.json .
paragraphs.zh: --from <channel> 会以与你自己的会话相同的信任级别恢复另一个安装自身的会话文件，包括自动恢复智能体。--from <path> 则将该文件视为不受信任：布局、工作目录、文本回滚缓冲和 http(s) 浏览器标签页会被恢复，但文件中的任何内容都不会自动运行。 内置智能体（Claude Code、Codex、Amp 等）使用 cmux 根据智能体类型和会话 id 构建的命令来恢复，忽略文件中存储的启动参数，并且仅当工作目录在这台 Mac 上已存在时才会恢复。 自定义智能体的恢复命令、恢复绑定和 tmux 启动命令仅保留用于手动恢复（已批准的恢复前缀从不适用于它们）：CLI 会报告有多少命令被扣留，并且在每个终端中，cmux surface resume show 会显示该命令，cmux restore --surface 会运行它。 回滚缓冲中的终端控制序列（剪贴板、通知、链接、标题）、草稿附件、非 http(s) 浏览器页面和配置文件、SSH/云连接，以及来自该文件的工作区环境变量都会被丢弃。 由更新版本的 cmux 保存的快照（更新的会话格式）会被拒绝并报错；如果降级后的 cmux 在自己的会话文件中发现此类快照，会在其旁边保留一份副本，命名为 session-<bundle id>.schema-v<N>.json。

paragraphs.en: Under the hood, cmux writes a versioned snapshot under ~/Library/Application Support/cmux/ and agent hooks write session mappings under ~/.cmuxterm/ . On restore, cmux rebuilds the layout first, then runs the supported agent's native resume command when automatic agent resume is enabled.
paragraphs.zh: 在底层，cmux 会在 ~/Library/Application Support/cmux/ 下写入带版本号的快照，而智能体钩子会在 ~/.cmuxterm/ 下写入会话映射。 在恢复时，cmux 会先重建布局，然后在启用智能体自动恢复的情况下，运行所支持智能体的原生恢复命令。

paragraphs.en: Read the full guide at https://cmux.com/docs/session-restore .
paragraphs.zh: 在 https://cmux.com/docs/session-restore 阅读完整指南。

paragraphs.en: cmux is not a fork of Ghostty. It uses libghostty as a library for terminal rendering, the same way apps use WebKit for web views. Ghostty is a standalone terminal; cmux is a different app built on top of its rendering engine.
paragraphs.zh: cmux 不是 Ghostty 的分支。 它使用 libghostty 作为终端渲染的库，就像应用使用 WebKit 来实现网页视图一样。 Ghostty 是一个独立的终端；cmux 则是构建在其渲染引擎之上的另一个应用。

paragraphs.en: All of them. cmux is a terminal, so any agent that runs in a terminal works out of the box: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Kiro, Aider, Goose, Amp, Cline, Cursor Agent, and anything else you can launch from the command line.
paragraphs.zh: 全部都支持。cmux 是一个终端，因此任何能在终端中运行的智能体都可以开箱即用：Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Gemini CLI、Kiro、Aider、Goose、Amp、Cline、Cursor Agent，以及任何其他可以从命令行启动的智能体。

paragraphs.en: Yes. When an agent spawns subagents or teammates, cmux turns them into native panes and splits instead of hidden background processes. It supports Claude Code teams and oh-my-opencode multi-model orchestration, so every agent in a run is visible and controllable.
paragraphs.zh: 是的。 当一个智能体生成子智能体或队友时，cmux 会将它们转换为原生的面板和分屏，而不是隐藏的后台进程。 它支持 Claude Code 团队和 oh-my-opencode 多模型编排，因此一次运行中的每个智能体都可见且可控制。

sents.en: Yes.
sents.zh: 是的。

paragraphs.en: When a process needs attention, cmux shows notification rings around panes, unread badges in the sidebar, a notification popover, and a macOS desktop notification. These fire automatically via standard terminal escape sequences (OSC 9/99/777), or you can trigger them with the cmux CLI and agent hooks . Any agent that supports hooks or OSC works, including Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and pi.
paragraphs.zh: 当某个进程需要关注时，cmux 会在窗格周围显示通知环、在侧边栏显示未读徽标、弹出通知弹窗，并发出 macOS 桌面通知。 这些通知通过标准终端转义序列（OSC 9/99/777）自动触发，你也可以通过 cmux CLI 和智能体钩子来手动触发。 任何支持钩子或 OSC 的智能体都可以使用，包括 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 和 pi。

paragraphs.en: Yes. Every action is available through the cmux CLI and a Unix socket: create workspaces, open split panes, send input, read screen contents, take screenshots, and drive the in-app browser. See the CLI reference and browser automation docs.

paragraphs.en: cmux can split a real browser pane next to your terminal, and it is fully programmable: navigate, snapshot the DOM, click, type, evaluate JavaScript, and read console and network activity over the same socket API. Agents use it to verify their own web changes without leaving cmux. See browser automation .
paragraphs.zh: cmux 可以在终端旁分割出一个真实的浏览器面板，并且它完全可编程：导航、对 DOM 进行快照、点击、输入、执行 JavaScript，以及通过同一个套接字 API 读取控制台和网络活动。 智能体无需离开 cmux 即可使用它来验证自己的网页更改。参见浏览器自动化。

paragraphs.en: cmux restores windows, workspaces, panes, working directories, and best-effort scrollback when you relaunch. Supported agent integrations can resume from their saved session IDs. Those are reconstructed app state and resume commands; they do not keep arbitrary live processes running. Use cmux local-tmux for live local detach/reattach across cmux quit, crashes, and updates. A local tmux server cannot survive logout, restart, shutdown, or power loss; use cmux ssh-tmux , cmux mosh-tmux , or a persistent cloud VM when the owner must remain online while this Mac is offline. See session restore and docs/local-tmux.md .
paragraphs.zh: 重新启动时，cmux 会恢复窗口、工作区、面板、工作目录，并尽力恢复回滚缓冲区。 受支持的智能体集成可以从其保存的会话 ID 恢复。 这些是重建的应用状态和恢复命令；它们不会让任意活动的进程持续运行。 使用 cmux local-tmux 可在 cmux 退出、崩溃和更新期间实现本地实时分离/重新连接。 本地 tmux 服务器无法在注销、重启、关机或断电后存活；当所有者必须在这台 Mac 离线时保持在线，请使用 cmux ssh-tmux、cmux mosh-tmux 或持久化的云端虚拟机。 请参阅会话恢复和 docs/local-tmux.md。

paragraphs.en: tmux is a terminal multiplexer that runs inside any terminal. cmux is a native macOS app with a GUI: vertical tabs, split panes, an embedded browser, and a socket API, all built in, no config files or prefix keys needed. That said, lots of people happily run cmux with SSH and tmux together, and cmux can attach to your remote tmux sessions natively ( beta ).
paragraphs.zh: tmux 是一个可在任何终端内运行的终端复用器；而 cmux 是一款原生的 macOS 图形界面应用：内置垂直标签页、分屏面板、嵌入式浏览器和 socket API，无需配置文件或前缀按键。 话虽如此，很多人还是乐于将 cmux 与 SSH 和 tmux 一起使用，并且 cmux 可以原生连接到你的远程 tmux 会话（beta 版）。
